authorization.scope: one direct foreground replay and fixed-window evaluation of the existing 239-snapshot PRO6 trajectory

decision_rule.candidate_pass: All values must be finite; candidate validation CE must be at least 0.002 below the production-selector right-only arm; candidate train CE must be no worse; and candidate validation distance from dense endpoint must be smaller than right-only.
decision_rule.on_failure: Treat the previous bilateral endpoint pass as a connectivity-target artifact and abandon output rotation as the next causal fix.
decision_rule.on_pass: Conclude that output-frame capacity remains real under the production selector but is trajectory-conditioned; do not retrain the same structure. Design a task-metric or dense-direction surrogate before another training run.

registered_change.angle_target: unchanged: full corrected update including candidate-specific decoupled weight decay and full compression-error carry
registered_change.connectivity_target: dense teacher non-decay Muon direction plus compression error divided by learning rate; excludes decoupled weight decay exactly as production does
registered_change.weight_decay_application: unchanged: multiply the post-rotation candidate by 1 - learning_rate * weight_decay

scientific_question: Does the bilateral endpoint CE gain survive when teacher-forced connectivity selection is made production-faithful by excluding decoupled weight decay?
